Sigma_correlation_matrix.notes: Precision Sigma^-1 defines d_G; Sigma defines the unconditional/conditional sampling distributions used for generation and for the geometry-side latent completion.

per_column_empirical_marginals.notes: Forward transform (raw->latent) is used to build every latent vector consumed by geometry; inverse transform (latent->raw) is used to realize every generated/completed sample.

deterministic_alphabetical_category_orde.notes: Deterministic transformation with no fitted parameters.

chemistry_summary_features.notes: Deterministic transformation of `formula` with no fitted parameters; enter the same latent model as any other numeric coordinate.
